Macrotech Developers Limited (known as Lodha) is Godrej Properties' most direct competitor for the title of India's largest residential property developer. In contrast, Godrej Properties operates an asset-light, multi-city residential development platform spanning Mumbai, NCR, Bengaluru, and Pune. While Godrej Properties demonstrates faster geographic diversification and rapid residential project launch velocity, DLF holds a significantly stronger balance sheet, fortress-like gross development margins, and substantial recurring rental income.
